scope_of_decision: Clearance only to seek and check a disproof of the explicit necessary quantitative assertion P, using its literal conventional objects and indexing. This is not a mathematical truth assessment or clearance to claim that a proof of P proves the full original assertion.

initial_gate.relationship: The initial gate deferred certification of a single complete meaning for every part of the original assertion. The present assessment addresses only whether its explicit main assertion is an invariant necessary claim under the unresolved parenthetical readings.

source_quotes.english_main_clause: The number of nonzero entries of the LR coefficient table (c^ν_{λμ})_{λ,μ,ν ⊢ n} is asymptotically c·4^n/n^{5/4}
source_quotes.english_parenthetical: (a density estimate for LR-realizable triples among all 4^n configurations)
source_quotes.chinese_main_clause: LR 系数表 (c^ν_{λμ})_{λ,μ,ν ⊢ n} 的非零项总数渐近为 c·4^n/n^{5/4}
source_quotes.chinese_parenthetical: (指数 4^n 中 LR 可实现三元组的密度估计)

necessary_assertion_P.parameter: n tends to positive infinity through the positive integers. The partition table may also be defined at n = 0; that finite initial index does not enter the positive-n limit expression.
necessary_assertion_P.partitions: Part(n) is the set of all integer partitions of n, in the usual sense. Every one of λ, μ and ν separately belongs to Part(n).
necessary_assertion_P.coefficients: LR denotes the actual Littlewood–Richardson coefficients on partition triples, conventionally the coefficients c^ν_{λμ} in the Schur-basis expansion s_λ s_μ = Σ_ν c^ν_{λμ} s_ν in symmetric functions, or an equivalent completely specified standard definition.
necessary_assertion_P.count: N(n) = #{(λ, μ, ν) ∈ Part(n) × Part(n) × Part(n) : c^ν_{λμ} ≠ 0}. These are ordered table indices. Entries are counted once each, without weights or an unstated quotient.
necessary_assertion_P.asymptotic: There exists a fixed finite real c > 0 such that N(n)/(c * 4^n / n^(5/4)) tends to 1 as n tends to infinity through positive integers. Equivalently, N(n) * n^(5/4) / 4^n tends to a fixed finite c > 0.
necessary_assertion_P.exponents: The base of the exponential is exactly 4 and its exponent is n. The denominator is the positive real power n^(5/4), where 5/4 is the rational number, not integer division. The constant c is independent of n and distinct from the indexed coefficient notation.
necessary_assertion_P.conventional_meaning_versus_hypotheses: The partition notation, the standard named coefficients, the usual nonzero-entry count, and a fixed positive leading constant under asymptotic equivalence explain the explicit source notation. They do not license extra restrictions on the displayed index set, auxiliary assumptions on the coefficients, a different notion of realizability, or a new counting model.

scope_reasoning: In both language versions the main clause directly asserts P. It is a complete quantitative assertion before the parenthesis begins.
If the parenthetical merely explains the intended normalization or motivation, the explicit necessary assertion remains P.

If the parenthetical adds a requirement Q about an ambient configuration family, realization relation, or density interpretation, the full assertion still entails P. This remains so if P and Q share quantified data: for example, an assertion that there exists c satisfying both the displayed asymptotic and further conditions entails the displayed existential assertion P.

Consequently, a checked proof of the exact logical negation of P suffices to refute every source-faithful reading in this gloss-or-additional-requirement class. It is not necessary to define or refute Q to establish that consequence.

The parenthetical has no wording that makes P conditional, supplies an exception, rebinds n, defines a different LR coefficient, or replaces the displayed index domain. Its undefined word configurations does not identify a competing formal domain.

A materially altered intended counting problem is conceivable, but selecting one would require repairing or overriding the explicit main clause. The source supplies no definite alteration to authorize. A disproof-only clearance must remain about the literal stated assertion and must not claim to settle any repaired or guessed intended conjecture.

remaining_ambiguity.exact_words: among all 4^n configurations; 指数 4^n 中 LR 可实现三元组的密度估计
remaining_ambiguity.unresolved: No configuration universe or realization map is defined, and the parenthetical’s role as gloss versus additional requirement remains unresolved.
remaining_ambiguity.effect_on_disproof_only_scope: This ambiguity does not withdraw the explicit assertion P under the ordinary grammatical readings above. It therefore does not block a disproof of P, while it continues to block a claim that proving P alone proves every possible requirement of the full original text.

required_future_obligations: Define actual integer partitions, the full finite ordered index set Part(n)^3, and the corresponding nonzero-entry count.

Give a faithful definition of the actual Littlewood–Richardson coefficients for every triple appearing in the source table. If starting from a restricted presentation, supply and justify the extension needed to interpret all displayed entries.

For a Schur-based development, provide the symmetric-function objects, Schur basis and coefficient extraction needed for that definition. For a tableau-based development, provide the actual shapes, filling/content conditions and Littlewood–Richardson conditions and connect the resulting count to the standard named coefficients.

Prove or properly import every property used about those actual objects; do not axiomatize selected convenient properties of an otherwise arbitrary surrogate function and call that a disproof of the named-coefficient statement.

Formalize and establish the negation of the complete existential positive-constant asymptotic assertion P, not merely failure at a chosen constant, a finite initial index, or a reformulated index domain.

Make the bridge between the formal theorem and the exact source-level necessary assertion explicit in the written report, including all quantifiers, real exponents and the direction of asymptotic equivalence.

State the logical scope honestly: refutation of P refutes the literal main claim and any conjunction that retains P. It makes no claim about an alternative intended problem obtained by changing the source.
Retain the initial full-meaning deferral and disclose the unresolved parenthetical when describing why a disproof can have adequate logical scope without resolving that additional language.
limitations: This record contains no determination that P is true or false, and no evidence bearing on that question.
No witness, computation, coefficient identity, structural obstruction, or mathematical proof/disproof strategy has been derived or supplied.
The clearance does not authorize treating the parenthetical as a hypothesis under which P is asserted; that conditional is absent from the source.

The clearance does not authorize proving the whole conjecture from P alone, replacing the index set, changing coefficient conventions, dropping positivity of the leading constant, or constructing a convenient meaning for configurations.
The clearance does not establish operational eligibility, submission admissibility, availability of a faithful formal development, or completion of any proof.
handoff: PASS_DISPROOF_ONLY for the exact explicit necessary assertion P, subject to the obligations and limitations above. The initial DEFER for complete full-statement meaning is preserved.
